title: A local record
hook: People who use a place can add observations to a survey.

knows: Animals interact with other organisms and their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: In a toy project, residents record nest locations that a separate survey did not visit. What information do their records add?

misconception: One observation or model rule gives a complete answer about nature.
objective: In a toy project, residents record nest locations that a separate survey did not visit. What information do their records add?

claims.text: In a toy project, residents record nest locations that a separate survey did not visit. What information do their records add? The first panel shows sites visited by one survey; the second adds residents’ reported nest locations. These are additional observations to check, not proof of complete coverage or survival.
claims.source: Unverified reference lead for independent check: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology and populations, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e . Exact claim-specific sources have not been verified.

claims.text: The panels depict a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
Residents report a nest outside a researcher’s surveyed area. What does that report add? The report adds a location that can be checked; it does not establish complete coverage.
